relationships.subject: HIF-1alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Hypoxia can stabilize the post-transcriptional levels of HIF-1α, and HIF-1α directly induces VEGF expression under hypoxic conditions (41,95,96).

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: In endothelial cells, TNF-α promotes angiogenesis by increasing the expression of VEGF, IL-8 and bFGF (103).

relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP-2 may promote angiogenesis, whereas MMP-9 may block angiogenesis by converting plasminogen into an angiogenesis inhibitor (106,107).

relationships.subject: HIF-1alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, Liu et al (80) found that HIF-1α increases the expression of COL2 and ACAN via the mediation of the NOTCH1 signalling pathway.

relationships.subject: PHD3
relationships.evidence_quote: PHD3 upregulates the TNF-α-induced NF-κB/p65 signaling activity to reinforce the expression of ADAMTS-5 and MMP-13; additionally it can downregulate the expression of the genes ACAN and COL2 (9,121).

key_findings: Review proposes HIF-1alpha as a double-edged regulator in intervertebral disc degeneration, friend in moderate hypoxia and foe in severe hypoxia.
HIF-1alpha drives VEGF-dependent angiogenesis, ECM metabolism and MMP expression in nucleus pulposus cells.
